Woe, which means great trouble, to those who cheat when they measure.
When they take from people, they take the full amount.
But when they measure or weigh for others, they give less.
Do they not think that they will be raised up again?
For a very great Day.
The Day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds.
No! The record of the wicked is in Sijjin, a place of lowness.
What can make you know what Sijjin is?
It is a book that is written.
Woe on that Day to those who denied.
Those who deny the Day of Judgment.
No one denies it except every sinful person who breaks the limits.
When Our verses are read to him he says: Old stories!
No! Their hearts are covered with rust from what they kept doing.
No! On that Day they will be kept away from their Lord.
Then they will enter Hell and burn.
Then it will be said to them: This is what you used to deny.
No! The record of the righteous is in Illiyyin, a place of highness.
What can make you know what Illiyyin is?
It is a book that is written.
Those who are close to Allah witness it.
The righteous will be in bliss.
On couches, looking around.
You will see on their faces the glow of happiness.
They will be given a pure drink that is sealed.
It will end with the smell of musk, a very good smell. So for this, let those who want to compete, compete.
It is mixed with a drink called Tasnim.
A spring from which those who are close to Allah drink.
The wrongdoers used to laugh at the believers.
When the believers passed by, they would wink at each other to make fun of them.
And when they went back to their people, they went back joking.
And when they saw the believers they said: These people are really lost!
But they were not sent to watch over the believers.
So today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers.
On couches, looking.
Have the disbelievers been paid back for what they used to do?
